headline.zh: 航空零件紧急采购决策

scenario.zh: 某航空制造商需要紧急采购500件钛合金连接件,在Axya平台上比较供应商并处理报价流程
scenario.en: An aerospace manufacturer needs 500 titanium connectors urgently, comparing suppliers and processing quotes in Axya

instruction.zh: 平台从8万家供应商中匹配符合条件的候选,选择筛选优先级
instruction.en: Platform matches qualified candidates from 80K suppliers, select filtering priority

label.zh: 优先交期最快的供应商

output.zh: 采购单已更新:候选供应商6家,最快交期18天,但单价较高,需要权衡成本与时间
output.en: Requisition updated: 6 candidates found, fastest is 18 days but higher unit cost, trade-off needed

label.zh: 优先历史合作良好的供应商

output.zh: 采购单已更新:候选供应商4家,均有3年以上合作记录,交期28天,价格稳定且质量可控
output.en: Requisition updated: 4 candidates with 3+ year history, 28-day lead time, stable pricing and quality

instruction.zh: AI已向候选供应商发送询价请求并收到回复,选择如何处理报价差异
instruction.en: AI sent RFQs to candidates and received responses, choose how to handle quote discrepancies

output.zh: 采购单已更新:选定供应商单价降低但交期延长至35天,AI标记风险提示需确认替代方案
output.en: Requisition updated: Selected supplier offers lower price but 35-day lead, AI flags risk for backup plan

label.en: Ask AI to negotiate balanced option

output.zh: 采购单已更新:AI向两家供应商提议联合供货,缩短交期至25天并保持预算内价格
output.en: Requisition updated: AI proposed split order to two suppliers, 25-day lead time within budget

instruction.zh: AI分析了两种采购方案的供应链风险,对比决策依据
instruction.en: AI analyzed supply chain risks for both procurement approaches, compare decision factors

output.zh: 风险评估:供应商财务稳定但产能紧张,AI检测到该供应商近期订单量激增可能影响交期
output.en: Risk assessment: Supplier financially stable but capacity tight, AI detects recent order surge may delay

output.zh: 风险评估:分散风险但协调成本增加,AI建议300件主供应商配200件备用以优化物流
output.en: Risk assessment: Diversified risk but higher coordination, AI suggests 300/200 split for logistics

instruction.zh: 审核最终采购方案,AI已准备好订单文档并同步至ERP系统
instruction.en: Review final procurement plan, AI prepared order documents and synced to ERP system

output.zh: 采购单已更新:订单已发送至双供应商,AI设置了里程碑提醒并持续监控交付进度和质量
output.en: Requisition updated: Order sent to both suppliers, AI set milestone alerts and monitors delivery progress

output.zh: 采购单已更新:方案已保存为草稿,AI总结了关键决策点和备选方案供团队评审
output.en: Requisition updated: Plan saved as draft, AI summarized key decisions and alternatives for team review

takeaway.zh: Axya用AI处理供应商匹配、报价谈判和风险评估,将制造业采购从邮件往来转变为智能决策流程
takeaway.en: Axya uses AI for supplier matching, quote negotiation and risk assessment, transforming manufacturing procurement from email threads into intelligent decisions

initial.zh: 零件:钛合金连接件TC-4 | 数量:500 | 交期:30天 | 质量:AS9100认证 | 预算:15万元
initial.en: Part: Titanium connector TC-4 | Qty: 500 | Lead time: 30 days | Quality: AS9100 cert | Budget: $22K
